themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of independent action, decision-making, and complex task execution within research and product development contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications designed to create, analyze, or optimize surveys and gather user feedback at scale.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and applications designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Addresses AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding comprehension and quick insights.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to automate software testing processes, improving efficiency and effectiveness in quality assurance.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research, development, and application of AI-powered chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the intersection of AI and design, exploring how AI can assist in the creative process and the research behind design decisions.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze customer data and behavior to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the overall workforce, including adaptation and potential displacement.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
